integrity: Reproducible self-contained analytic proof with accompanying executable finite checks; finite checks are not infinite-time proofs; no claim of externally certified originality or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic independence-based SIS closure only, not exact stochastic epidemic paths; finite connected undirected simple graphs with at least two vertices and uniform 0<recovery_probability<1; first-order asymptotic only; full-text coverage of an earlier discrete SIS article could not be decided.
title: An exact critical-relaxation gap between discrete epidemic models with and without same-step reinfection
